newsitem.title: USA: CNF Transport names Quesnel president, COO.
newsitem.headline: CNF Transport names Quesnel president, COO.

text.p: CNF Transportation Inc said Monday it had named Gregory Quesnel as president and chief operating officer.
As president, Quesnel replaces Donald Moffitt, who remains chairman of the board and chief executive officer. Moffit has previously said he plans to retire as chief executive next spring.
CNF said in a statement that Quesnel, 49, had been CNF's chief financial officer.
Quesnel joined CNF in 1975 as director of financial accounting. In 1989 he was elected vice president-accounting of CNF, and in 1991 he was made CFO.
